records.label: current
records.learner: Jason, I did sit on the feedback, that's on me. But the doc had no acceptance criteria and I got stuck there.

npc.text: Okay, but if you got stuck, you could've just pinged me. Two weeks of silence, and now I'm hearing about acceptance criteria for the first time, in front of everyone.
Let's not relitigate the two weeks. What do you two need to get this unstuck?

records.label: current
records.learner: 我有点不同意。Marcus 的结论依赖一个前提，但材料里没有证据支持它。

npc.text: 哪个前提？我刚才说的每一步都是从材料推出来的，你说没证据，总得指出是哪一句吧。
好，这个质疑有意思。说具体点——你指的是 Marcus 论证里的哪一环？

records.label: current
records.learner: Jason，反馈确实是我拖了，这点我认。不过文档里缺了验收标准，我卡在那儿了。

npc.text: 你认就行。但缺验收标准，你直接问我一句不就完了？卡两周才在会上说，我怎么知道你卡在哪儿。
好，先别翻旧账。缺的东西说清楚，然后定个时间。

records.label: current
records.learner: 教授，您觉得我刚才说的那个前提，算不算一个合理的质疑？

npc.text: 合不合理，我现在还判断不了，因为我还不知道你指的是哪个前提。你先把它说出来，用你自己的话讲讲 Marcus 的推理是怎么走的，卡在哪儿。
对，你先说是哪一个。不说出来，我也没法回应。

records.label: current
records.learner: Sam, what's your read? Should I fix my side first, or do we fill the gaps in the doc?

npc.text: My read? It's not either-or. Get Jason feedback on what's there, and send him your questions on the criteria along with it. When can you do that?
And I'm sitting right here. If something's missing from the doc, ask me. I'd rather hear it from you than from Sam.

records.label: current
records.learner: Sam，你怎么看？是我这边该先改，还是我们先把文档补全？

npc.text: 等下，你问Sam干嘛？我人就坐这儿。缺什么你跟我说啊。
这不是二选一。你直接跟Jason说缺哪几项，他补；然后你给个反馈时间。别在会上绕。

records.label: current
records.learner: Anna，你刚才一直没说话，你觉得我刚才那样讲公平吗？

npc.text: 啊……我？我觉得，嗯，你们俩说的都有道理吧。要不就像Sam说的，把缺的列一下，定个时间？
你看，你又绕开我了。先问Sam，现在又问Anna，我都快成局外人了。你到底什么时候给我反馈？

records.label: current
records.learner: Marcus，你怎么回应我刚才的问题？

npc.text: 我的回应就是：我不觉得有哪个前提缺证据。你要是不同意，就别绕了，直接说是我推理里哪一步，开头那步、中间那步，还是结论之前那步都行。
我插一句：不用一次说完整，你就先讲讲你理解的 Marcus 的论证是什么，从那儿开始也可以。

records.label: current
records.learner: Anna, you've been quiet. Was what I just said fair?

npc.text: Oh, um… I don't really want to grade anyone here. I think you both have a point? But Jason's right there, so maybe just talk it through with him.
Yeah, why are we polling the room? I'm the one who's been waiting. Sam asked you a simple question: when?

records.label: current
records.learner: I see it a bit differently. Marcus's conclusion rests on an assumption the readings don't support.

npc.text: Okay, which assumption? Because I'm pretty sure I'm not sneaking anything in.
Good, let's hear it. Can you tell us what you understood Marcus to be arguing, and then where you think it breaks down?

records.label: current
records.learner: Doug, hold on. I'd like to hear Mei finish her point first.

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: I'd like to hear Mei finish her point first.
objectiveEvidence.npcQuote: Thanks. Um, so what I was actually trying to say

npc.text: Oh! Yeah, sure, sorry. Go for it, Mei.

Thanks. Um, so what I was actually trying to say is a bit different from a phased rollout. It's more that we test it with one group first and let what we learn there decide the rest. But, I mean, if that overlaps with Doug's idea...

records.label: current
records.learner: Doug，等一下，我想先听 Mei 把她刚才的想法说完。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 我想先听 Mei 把她刚才的想法说完

npc.text: 哦——行行，你说你说。我就是怕跑题，顺手接了一下。
……谢谢。那我接着刚才说，其实我的意思跟「分阶段上线」不太一样，我是想先——

records.label: current
records.learner: Professor, does the assumption I just pointed to count as a fair objection?

npc.text: It might be. I can't tell yet, because you haven't told us what the assumption is. Name it, and tell us why you think the readings don't back it up.
Yeah, I'd actually like to know. Which part do you think I'm assuming?

records.label: current
records.learner: Mei, where were you going with the phased rollout?

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: I'd like to hear Mei finish her point first.
objectiveEvidence.npcQuote: Thanks. Um, so what I was actually trying to say

npc.text: Well, it's not really a phased rollout. A phased rollout assumes we're going ahead no matter what. I'm saying the one group is a real test. If it doesn't work there, we change it or we stop, before anyone else gets—
Right, right, so pilot first, then phase it in. That's what I've been saying. So for the first phase, I'd—

records.label: current
records.learner: Marcus, how would you answer what I just asked?

npc.text: I can't, honestly. You haven't said what the assumption is, so right now I'm defending against a mystery. Give me the actual point and I'll answer it.
Start smaller if it helps. Just say back what you heard Marcus claim, in your own words, and we'll go from there.

records.label: current
records.learner: Mei，你刚才说到分阶段上线的哪一步了？

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 我想先听 Mei 把她刚才的想法说完

npc.text: 呃，其实不是分阶段上线那个……我是想，上线之前先找一小批用户试用，看他们实际怎么用，再决定后面要不要分阶段、怎么分。
诶，这个好！其实就是我说的第一阶段嘛，咱们可以先圈一批种子用户，然后——

records.label: current
records.learner: Doug, I just cut you off. Did that seem out of line to you?

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: I'd like to hear Mei finish her point first.
objectiveEvidence.npcQuote: Thanks. Um, so what I was actually trying to say

npc.text: Out of line? No, no, you're fine, I just get going sometimes. ...Wait. Hang on, are you saying I just did that to Mei?

records.label: current
records.learner: Doug，我刚才打断你了，你觉得我这样做不合适吗？

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 我想先听 Mei 把她刚才的想法说完

npc.text: 啊？没有没有，完全没问题！我这人一兴奋嘴就停不下来，你拦一下挺好。那咱们接着说种子用户这个第一阶段，我觉得名单可以——
……其实试用跟第一阶段不是一回事，不过……算了，你们先说吧。

records.label: current
records.learner: Dad, I've thought it through. It isn't a whim. I saved a year of living costs before deciding.

records.learner: 放心，黑历史我留着下次再讲。我和 Hana 认识十年了，她是那种你半夜打电话一定会接的人。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 放心，黑历史我留着下次再讲。

npc.text: 好好好，下次再讲，你可记着啊！哎，十年……你这么一说我突然觉得自己好老。
半夜打电话？哪一次啊！讲讲讲！

records.label: current
records.learner: 爸，我想清楚了。我不是一时冲动，我存了一年的生活费才做的决定。

npc.text: 存了一年？一年够干什么的。我们那时候，谁不是先把饭碗端稳了再说别的。人家都说创业公司十个里头九个撑不下去，一年以后要是黄了，你怎么办？
哎，先吃菜，边吃边说……孩子，你那个新公司，社保什么的还给交吗？

records.label: current
records.learner: 大家觉得我这句开场怎么样？要不要再来一个？

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 放心，黑历史我留着下次再讲。

npc.text: 开场过关过关！别再来了，我们要听半夜那个电话！
哈哈哈，你是不是还没想好在这儿拖时间？大家酒杯都举酸了啊。

records.label: current
records.learner: 妈，你一直没说话，你是不是也觉得我太冒险了？

npc.text: 我哪是没说话……我就是怕你累。冒不冒险我也说不好，我就想知道，你去了那边每个月还有没有准钱，万一生个病，有没有保障？
你妈刚才问你社保的事，你还没回答呢。还有我那句，一年以后要是黄了，你怎么打算？

records.label: current
records.learner: Hana，你觉得我刚才说得太煽情了吗？

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: 放心，黑历史我留着下次再讲。

npc.text: 不煽情啊，刚刚好……我其实还挺爱听的。哎你别问我了，你一问我反而不好意思了！
别互相客气了！半夜电话！半夜电话！

records.label: current
records.learner: 爸，你跟妈私下聊过我这件事吗？你们最担心的是什么？

npc.text: 聊过，怎么没聊。最担心的？就是你把稳当的路扔了，到时候进退两难，三十来岁再回头找工作，人家还要不要你。我把话说完了，你别光问我们，刚才那两个问题你也得给个说法。
我就是怕你一个人在外头熬，饭也不好好吃，身体搞垮了……钱的事倒在其次。

records.label: current
records.learner: Relax, the embarrassing stories can wait. I've known Hana ten years. She's the person who picks up at 3am.

npc.text: Ooooh, ‘can wait’ — so there ARE stories! 3am, huh? Who's calling her at 3am?
Okay, okay, that's — hey, don't start, I'm already wearing mascara. Which 3am are we talking about, though? Be careful.

records.label: current
records.learner: Victor，我不太同意。把一整群人说成不想努力，这个说法不公平。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: Victor，我不太同意。把一整群人说成不想努力，这个说法不公平。

npc.text: 不公平？我说的是我亲眼看到的情况好吗。怎么，说句实话就成坏人了？
哎哎，那个……甜点马上好了，谁要再来点酒？

records.label: current
records.learner: Victor, I don't agree. Saying a whole group of people won't work hard isn't fair.

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: Victor, I don't agree. Saying a whole group of people won't work hard isn't fair.

npc.text: Oh, come on, 'isn't fair'? I'm just saying what everybody sees and nobody wants to say out loud. You're telling me you've never noticed?
Okay, um, who needs a top-up? There's still half a bottle of the red here...

records.label: current
records.learner: How was that for an opener, everyone? Should I keep going?

npc.text: Six out of ten, needs more 3am! Keep going, our arms are getting tired up here!
Don't ask them, they'll rate anything. You can't just say ‘3am' and leave me hanging. Go on, which one?

（小声）你们俩……慢慢聊，别太大声就行啊。

objectiveEvidence.learnerQuote: Relax, the embarrassing stories can wait.

Story! Story! Story!
